choices.content: Extend a median to twice its length
Cut the longer segment or extend the shorter segment

question.prompt: When proving a sum or difference relationship between segment lengths, such as $a=b+c$, which auxiliary construction method is commonly used?

solutions.explanation: To prove $a=b+c$, mark off a segment of length $b$ on the longer segment $a$ and prove that the remainder equals $c$ (cutting the longer segment), or extend $b$ by a segment of length $c$ (extending the shorter segment). This is the method of cutting the longer segment or extending the shorter segment.
solutions.title: Recognize cutting and extending
